questions.question_en: Is the little rabbit's name Barnaby?
Did Barnaby find a carrot under a green leaf?
questions.question_ko: 바나비는 초록 잎사귀 아래에서 당근을 찾았나요?

questions.question_en: Did the little bird tell Barnaby the apple was a carrot?
questions.question_ko: 작은 새는 바나비에게 사과가 당근이라고 말했나요?
questions.feedback_en: No, the bird said it was an apple!
